show_title: Hound PodCast: Double U Hunting Supply
title: Gone To The Dogs – Lone Pine Legacy Update
summary: Steve and Randy share a wealth of information vital to anyone aspiring to make the bigtime in the coonhound world, whether as a breeder, trainer or competitor. Additionally much important information is provided in the realm of raising healthy litters. When Randy Smith talks, veterans and novice hunters alike come to attention.
